policy: Predeclared before training: evaluate all13VAL after each saved epoch; lexicographic gate pass,F1,precision,recall,AP50-95; retain earliest exact tie; native12fitness is diagnostic only.
completion: Strip selected checkpoint then independently rerun fullVAL, observed negative/regression gates; fresh independent TEST/PICO required for acceptance.
limitations: Training data supervision and checkpoint-selection policy both change relative to v18, so no single-factor causal claim.
Repeated VAL model selection is development use and cannot establish fresh TEST generalization.
